description: Use when an agent needs platform-level context before drilling into individual markets: one row per platform with complete figures (Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold, Myriad, Limitless, Predict, Opinion, Gemini, Hyperliquid, MNX, Seer, XO Market) carrying 24h volume in each venue's own unit, active event and market counts, and that platform's category mix. Takes no parameters and returns the whole picture in one small response, and answers in one call questions such as 'how big is X relative to Y' or 'which platform covers this topic'. Each row also splits out the volume on events still open and, where measured, lists the dated volume of the markets pdata leaves out (intraday markets, Kalshi combos), which no total includes. Real-money volume uses notional dollars. Manifold uses play-money mana. Cross-venue totals cover Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold, Predict, Opinion, Limitless, Myriad and Gemini. Hyperliquid, Seer, MNX and XO Market are excluded by design. The response names venues missing complete figures in unavailable_sources.
name: get_summary
title: Per-platform summary
